title: Lacatski's warning that Yankee Blue was a psyop

tellings.quote: saying um Yankee Blue. That was a That was a psyop.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, passes on a warning he links to James Lacatski, a former government official, and to George Knapp, a television journalist. According to Corbell, the word was that Yankee Blue, a name said to belong to a secret program, was a psyop, meaning a deliberate operation to deceive or steer people. If so, people chasing that program would have been following planted information.
